change_log.change: Add relation attributes 'Convergence' and 'Convergence_Location' (Pattern C, symmetric two-line convergence). Pure relation attributes: value=null, relation_target drawn from relation_target_registry, matched via palm_rules_table match()'s existing targets channel. Symmetry handled by CANONICALIZATION at extraction time (owner = alphabetically-first feature of the pair, target = the other). Convergence = 'line A meets line B'; Convergence_Location (single generic slot) = a third landmark associated with that convergence (either the meeting point or a shared continuation landmark, e.g. F025b fate+heart ascend Jupiter) -- disambiguated in claim prose, NOT structurally split, because vision (gpt-4o) reliability on meet-at vs continue-to is below floor; all location-gated C rules carry a LOWER-CONFIDENCE flag. change_log.author: chat, awaiting Sulabh validation
change_log.change: S123 dead-flat-field fix, Step 1b (data-only, additive): review-stage correction to the 1.13.0 addition, before any wiring lands. 1.13.0's '_note' said every captured vision_flat_subfields value unconditionally WINS over an LLM-extracted value for the same (feature, attribute) -- true for SLOPE/SLOPE MAGNITUDE, whose menus equal their attribute's ENTIRE attribute_value_binding, but UNSAFE for BREAK TYPE/LENGTH EXTENT, whose menus are small proper subsets of Continuity's ~17-value range and Length's wide range: unconditional overwrite would let a fill_only BREAK TYPE=broken silently clobber a plain-sentence Continuity=double and kill FT_013 while fixing FT_012 -- fixing two rules while breaking a third. Fix: add a 'write_policy' key to all 8 existing entries, each value DERIVED (not hand-asserted) by comparing that entry's 'menu' against attribute_value_binding[attribute] (or the full flattened values pool if the attribute has no binding) -- equal sets => 'authoritative' (SLOPE, SLOPE MAGNITUDE: menu overwrites on collision, unchanged from 1.13.0's original semantics), proper subset => 'fill_only' (BREAK TYPE, LENGTH EXTENT: may write only into an EMPTY (feature, attribute) slot, must never overwrite). All 8 derived assignments were verified programmatically against the ratified expectation before writing -- 8/8 MATCH, zero contradictions, so nothing needed to stop. '_note' semantics (ii) rewritten to state both policies and the derivation rule that produces them; semantics (i) (escape values dropped, never written) is UNCHANGED and applies to both policies alike. No new feature, attribute, or value token added; no menu, feature, or attribute assignment changed from 1.13.0 -- only 'write_policy' keys and the '_note' prose were added/rewritten.
change_log.no_code_consumes_yet: Still purely additive/corrective to 'vision_flat_subfields' plus meta/change_log only -- no other top-level block touched. attribute_value_binding re-verified byte-identical to HEAD (unchanged since before 1.13.0). Nothing in agent/interpretive/ or agent/palm_processor.py reads 'vision_flat_subfields' or 'write_policy' yet -- confirmed inert by a full green suite run at the pre-existing baseline count, unchanged. Wiring is still a later step in the same arc, not done here.

vision_relational_menus._note: Only closed per-line menus are listed here: ORIGIN, TERMINATION. CONVERGENCE and CONVERGENCE_LOCATION are NOT listed here -- see '_convergence_note'/'_location_note' below. BRANCHES_TO and the PROXIMITY landmark are also deliberately excluded -- both validate against the full relation_target_registry (an open landmark-name pool shared across every relational line), not a per-line closed list; there is no per-line menu to transcribe for them.
vision_relational_menus._convergence_note: CONVERGENCE menu for any line = convergence_lines MINUS that line itself, derived at prompt-build time (Generic convergence emission step, S98). Multi-select (a line may cross several other lines at once -- Pattern D). Not hand-listed per line here; adding a new line to convergence_lines auto-participates with zero further vision-prompt edits. RETIRED for Head/Heart/Fate (typed-relationship arc Step 5d, S99) -- their CONVERGENCE field was removed from the vision prompt in favor of the typed RELATIONSHIP channel; the derivation mechanism itself is untouched, and this menu is still live for Line of Life ONLY (Life has no RELATIONSHIP field, so it still needs this channel).
vision_relational_menus._location_note: RETIRED (typed-relationship arc Step 5d, S99) -- Line of Fate's CONVERGENCE_LOCATION menu (formerly listed above, the single-partner F025b case) was removed along with Fate's CONVERGENCE field, both superseded by the typed RELATIONSHIP channel's own 'at <mount>' clause. No line currently declares a CONVERGENCE_LOCATION menu; kept as a historical pointer in case a future line ever needs one again -- when multi-partner locations are needed, capture as a list index-aligned to the (ordered) partner list -- one location per crossing, same order (ratified S98).

vision_flat_subfields._note: Closed menus for the FLAT (non-relational) closed sub-fields agent/palm_processor.py emits as indented lines under a line's own HEAD/HEART/FATE LINE header -- SLOPE (all three lines), and BREAK TYPE/LENGTH EXTENT (Line of Fate only). S123 diagnosed these fields as emitted on every hand and then read by NOTHING: they match neither palm_reading._gather_feature_texts's flat-label lookup nor observation_extractor._RELATIONAL_SUBFIELD's regex, so the values never reach `observation` or `targets`. This block is Step 1 of the S123 fix (data-only, additive, deliberately inert -- no consumer reads it yet). Unlike vision_relational_menus, every entry here carries a FLAT scalar value keyed to an ontology ATTRIBUTE, never a relation_target -- these values belong in the flat `observation` dict, exactly like Development, never in `targets`. SLOPE MAGNITUDE has NO live vision-prompt field yet (Step 3 of this arc adds the prompt text); its menu is declared here ahead of that step as Slope_Magnitude's existing, UNCHANGED attribute_value_binding {slight, very} -- ratified S123 Option B, reviving the already-declared Slope_Magnitude attribute rather than widening Slope's own binding (which would introduce a new straight-vs-slight boundary and put FT_003's Slope=straight requirement at risk). Menu wording for SLOPE/BREAK TYPE/LENGTH EXTENT is transcribed verbatim from agent/palm_processor.py's literal prompt text, not invented. Two semantics any future consumer of this block MUST honour: (i) an ESCAPE value ('not clearly visible' for SLOPE, 'n/a' for SLOPE MAGNITUDE/BREAK TYPE/LENGTH EXTENT) means honest silence -- it is DROPPED, never written, and must never overwrite a value another channel already supplied for that (feature, attribute); (ii) a non-escape value's write behavior is governed by this entry's own `write_policy` key, NOT a blanket rule -- REVIEW CORRECTION (1.14.0, before any wiring): the original 1.13.0 wording said every captured value unconditionally WINS over any LLM-extracted value, which is only true when this field's `menu` equals its attribute's ENTIRE legal value range. `write_policy` is DERIVED, not hand-asserted -- compare `menu` against `attribute_value_binding[attribute]` if the attribute has a binding, else against the full flattened `values` pool: equal sets => `"authoritative"`; `menu` a PROPER SUBSET => `"fill_only"`. Any future edit to a menu must re-derive this key the same way, never hand-copy it. `"authoritative"` (SLOPE, SLOPE MAGNITUDE -- each menu already equals its attribute's own binding) behaves as originally specified: the captured value WINS over any LLM-extracted value for the same (feature, attribute) on collision, mirroring the existing Proximity ('P-wins') and Development ('Development-wins') merge precedent in palm_reading.prepare_palm_reading. `"fill_only"` (BREAK TYPE, LENGTH EXTENT -- each menu is a small proper subset of Continuity's ~17-value / Length's wide range) is NARROWER: it may write ONLY when that (feature, attribute) slot is still EMPTY, and must NEVER overwrite a value already present from any other channel -- unconditional overwrite here would let, e.g., a fill_only BREAK TYPE=broken clobber a plain-sentence Continuity=double and silently kill FT_013 while fixing FT_012, trading one dead rule for another. This block's eventual consumer must merge AFTER to_tokens(), the same way Proximity/Development already do, not route through the LLM-mediated extraction path, for BOTH policies -- only the overwrite-vs-fill-empty condition differs between them.
